result.label: Kirchberg's ` O_2` norm-ultrapower embedding problem
result.statement: Constructs an explicit separable unital full group C ∗ -algebra that cannot embed unitally into the norm ultrapower of any fixed nonzero unital nuclear C ∗ -algebra, for any free ultrafilter on the natural numbers. Taking the target to be O2 answers Kirchberg's norm-ultrapower embedding problem negatively.
